ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of sweeping the house according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) links domestic tidiness to divine provision, reflecting the Shia emphasis on 'Taharah' (purity) as a holistic state encompassing both physical and spiritual realms. Scholars often interpret 'removing poverty' not merely as material wealth but as the removal of spiritual and existential lack, aligning with the Prophetic tradition that cleanliness is half of faith. This practice is viewed as a means of inviting barakah (blessing) into the household, thereby fostering an environment conducive to both material stability and spiritual growth.

en.hubeali:
From him, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
Sweeping the house negates the poverty’.
en.sarwar: 8. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from certain persons of his people in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Sweep the house, it removes poverty.’”
